name: EU AI Act — remote biometric identification (high-level)
description: Conservative defaults for real-time / post remote biometric identification. Pack encodes product policy, not a full statutory engine.

meta.note: Real-time RBI in publicly accessible spaces is heavily restricted; post-remote also conditioned
meta.product_stance: Untargeted mass ID remains prohibited at OBP lawful-basis layer; this pack reinforces ODP reads

rules.deny_reason: Real-time / patrol biometric identification in public-like contexts denied without dedicated statutory pack override

rules.on_fail_reason: Post-remote biometric ID requires documented case / authorization record
